§ Succoth-benoth = "the daughter's booth"
Assyrian or Babylonian deity worshipped by the Babylonians in Samaria

strongs_1890.strongs_def: booths of (the) daughters; brothels, i.e. idoalatrous tents forimpure purpose
strongs_1890.derivation: from H5523 (סֻכּוֹת) and the (irregular) plural of H1323 (בַּת);
